T6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A layer cell is BINARY here -- a gene is in the reaction layer or it is not. The
architecture needs VALUES, not membership, so every count above is optimistic: a
filled cell may still lack the rate constant the chain actually needs.
Five layers is this repo's inventory, not the cell's. A real chain also needs
receptors, kinases, transport and localisation, none of which are layers here.
The question set is every ordered layer pair, which weights all questions equally.
A real user asks a biased set, and a biased set could need far fewer links -- this
design cannot say which bias, so T4 is an upper bound on the work and T5 a lower
bound on the reuse.
Nothing here says a missing link is COMPUTABLE. Loops 131-133 and 184 measured that
the rate-determined ones are not, and loop 156 measured that growth does not need
them anyway. Which bucket a link falls in is loop 205, not this loop.
